# Root-foundation review package

**Evolutionary comparative direction, 8 October 2026.** [The assessment](EVOLUTION-COMPARATIVE-DIRECTION.md) distinguishes predictive gain, explanatory economy and tested connected scope. It identifies strong primary comparators and proposes a joint mechanism/changed-condition test, with data-readiness limits and author counterreview. No new proof or forecast is claimed; prior mechanisms and the six full-theory requirements remain intact.

# SOURCES manifest

**Evolutionary comparison direction, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s request](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-evolution-comparative-direction.md) distinguishes the direct instruction from quoted assistant wording. The [link-only primary reading record](evolutionary-selection/comparative-direction/README.md) covers Black et al. at abstract scope, selected Bourrat full text and selected Watson–Levin–Buckley sections. No source simulation or biological replication is added.

### Direction for demonstrating a comparative contribution

[The comparative-direction assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EVOLUTION-COMPARATIVE-DIRECTION.md) distinguishes predictive gain, explanatory economy and tested connected scope. The proposed contribution is to explain the formation, inheritance and revision of the organization through which evolution proceeds. Existing ecological scaffolding, scaffold endogenization and evolutionary connectionism are strong comparators; neither changing selection conditions nor connecting evolution and learning is by itself a new achievement.

The first proposed test asks whether independently constrained developmental and sampling mechanisms predict complete-cycle continuation under a changed condition without a new terminal-success rate fitted to that condition. Give the conventional mechanistic rival the same observations and an adequate fitting procedure. Test the additional restriction or justified reuse supplied by our framework; if the accounts become equivalent, claim their agreement and only whatever explanatory economy or wider tested scope remains. The current surface-history result is already credited; its missing timing and descendant correspondence still prevent this joint calibration.

**比较方向：**先检验独立机制约束是否减少跨条件接续预测的另行拟合，再推进重构／选择关系自身的演化及跨领域机制对应。方向评估已完成，优越性尚未实证；全部六项完成要求不变。

# Generative grounding of significance and learning

**Comparative evolutionary direction, 8 October 2026.** [The new assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EVOLUTION-COMPARATIVE-DIRECTION.md) targets the unresolved derivation from measured formation and inheritance to continuation under changed conditions, then to changes in reconstruction and selection relations. Its proposed gain is fewer independently fitted outcome laws or additional tested scope against strong mechanistic rivals. Supplied local laws remain visible; explanatory equivalence receives credit. This supports calibration of generative alignment without reopening completed ethical arguments or claiming universal favorable dynamics.

edits.old: ## 1. Shared dependence and the selection of its maintenance
edits.new:
### Comparative direction for generated selection

[The comparative assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EVOLUTION-COMPARATIVE-DIRECTION.md) makes the proposed advantage explicit: independently grounded relations should constrain formation, inherited reconstruction and continuation across changed conditions, then explain revisions to those relations. Existing scaffolding, endogenization and evolutionary connectionist accounts are substantive rivals. Compare against the same evidence and mechanisms; a removed-history baseline cannot establish broad superiority. The first candidate test joins actual development and sampling to new cycle outcomes without fitting a new success law for the test condition. Existing recurrence, development and surface-history results retain their scope, while the required common timing/descendant record remains missing.

## 1. Shared dependence and the selection of its maintenance

before.title_en: Recursive influence of generation on selection
before.claim_zh: 活动后果可改变后继形成与选择条件，贡献变体不必获益。重构、发育与聚合区分遗传群体和运输集合；细菌回复实验接通遗传切换与周期完成。谱系预测保留总体优势及局部失败。新增原始实证支持呼吸形成氧梯度并改变后续选择；结构形成史须接入发育迁移，常规解释获完整信用。 原始延时研究进一步记录界面小筏形成、下落和再形成；酸碱条件改变空间组织，须与持续膜结构和实际后代分别对应。
before.claim_en: Consequences can change successor formation and selection without guaranteeing contributor advantage. Reconstruction, development and aggregation distinguish inherited clusters from transport groups; bacterial reversion links switching to cycle completion. Lineage forecasts retain aggregate gains and local failures. Primary evidence now links respiration-generated oxygen gradients to changed selection; structural development must enter transferable prediction. Conventional explanation receives full credit. Original time-lapse research adds recurring surface rafts and pH-sensitive spatial organization, requiring separate correspondences for persistent mat structure and actual descendants.
before.scope_zh: 保留16/26、19/41、7/13及6/6定理/审计与反例；本轮无新定理。54段视频/18项技术重复、33/190敏感性、3,808记录/3,600联系及42/72对7/72保持范围；3,424项预测及139分组/485行核验保留。新核对八项生长及两项竞争摘要，不能转作周期概率。初始未形成与后来失效须区分；联合校准、广泛比较与支持更新仍开放。 新保存四份影片，44帧像素对应核验通过；帧数不是重复。基因标签、拍摄时钟及后代联系未齐，未拟合周期概率。
before.scope_en: Preserves 16/26, 19/41, 7/13 and 6/6 theorem/audit results and counterexamples; no new theorem. The 54 videos/18 technical replicates, 33/190 sensitivity, 3,808 records/3,600 links, 42/72 versus 7/72, 3,424 forecasts and 139-cohort/485-row checks retain their scopes. Eight growth and two competition summaries cannot become cycle probabilities. Initial absence versus later loss, joint calibration, broad comparison and support renewal remain open. Four original movies are preserved and 44 selected-frame correspondences pass; frames are not replicates. Exact genotype attribution, acquisition timing and linked descendants remain incomplete; no cycle probability is fitted.
